lines.quote: Designed and implemented adaptive beamforming algorithms for a 64-element L-band phased-array receiver used in ground-based remote-sensing applications.
Wrote C firmware for a TI C6748 DSP module that performs real-time pulse compression and digital down-conversion from the raw ADC stream.
Built and maintain a production Python pipeline (~12k lines) for automated phased-array calibration.

Conducted antenna gain pattern measurements and RF front-end characterisation for the S-band downlink chain, working with vector network analysers and spectrum analysers in Tuulenkaari's shielded chamber facility
